title: Second simulation advance label
statement: For a machine $N$, simulation information $I$, Boolean flags $f_0,f_1$, simulation state $st$, and natural number $i$, define a label as follows: if $i<2$, it is the second advance label carrying $I,f_0,f_1,st$ and the index $i$; otherwise it is the simulation test label carrying $I,f_0,f_1,st$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean nondeterministic Turing machine N
